end.summary:
Discussed ants, beetles, and earthworms found in soil.
Considered where soil animals may hide after rain.
Practised observing a drawing and choosing a safe tool instead of bare hands.
Lesson stopped when Pihu said they were tired; teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying soil animals, thinking about where they hide, and handling them safely using a picture prompt. Pihu suggested looking under leaves and using a stick rather than bare hands. There was a mix-up about earthworms harming soil, and it was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, look at a garden picture or real soil animals together and ask, “What do you notice, and where might it hide?”
